firm_data.firm_description: McGivney Kluger Clark & Intoccia is one of the nation’s premier defense firms representing a diverse range of clients, from large corporations and insurance companies to small businesses and individuals. Our attorneys have the background and experience to skillfully defend complex cases and provide effective legal representation in local, state, federal and multi-district jurisdictions.
notable_facts: Represents a diverse range of clients from large corporations to individuals

email.subject: AI for McGivney Kluger Clark & Intoccia, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Charles,

Your firm's work across toxic tort and product liability defense at scale, spanning 9 jurisdictions, caught our attention. That kind of complexity demands precision tools most firms simply don't have.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for defense firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across the East Coast have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of sophisticated practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

We're now expanding regionally to meet firms like McGivney Kluger Clark & Intoccia. I'd be happy to stop by your Livingston office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on discovery, document review, and case strategy.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
